about.name: Cathereen David
descriptionParagraphs:
Hi, I’m Cathereen David, a Cybersecurity graduate focused on network security and threat detection. I specialize in bridging the gap between security theory and practical defense, a skillset I developed through hands-on enterprise experience as an intern at MEC Networks Corporation. There, I worked directly with industry-standard technologies like Fortinet and Aruba to configure and deploy secure network solutions. I am also deeply interested in proactive defense; for my thesis, I developed a real-time phishing detection tool using machine learning, and I regularly sharpen my incident-response skills in competitive environments—even earning Champion at a Trend Micro Capture-the-Flag competition.

What drives me as a security professional is the challenge of analyzing environments, uncovering vulnerabilities, and stopping threats before they impact an organization. Backed by a strong suite of certifications including CCNA, AWS Cloud Security, and Fortinet. I am built to thrive in fast-paced security operations. I am currently looking to leverage my analytical mindset and technical foundation in a Security Analyst role, and I'm always open to connecting with fellow professionals or exploring new opportunities to help keep digital ecosystems secure.
